changed: The theme as Matt reviewed it: libadwaita colours, a flat header bar, grey round window buttons, GNOME accent.
gaps: Text is DejaVu Sans (the Flatpak can't see Adwaita Sans) and small and bold. One header bar runs across all columns. Selection is a full-width accent bar, rows are dense with divider lines, and the sidebar selection is a square block.

changed: Adwaita Sans at last (the Flatpak couldn't see system fonts, so the login hook now copies it into the user's font folder). The selection is a neutral rounded pill instead of a full-width blue bar, the checkboxes are gone, sidebar rows are pills, and the window buttons are on the right.
gaps: The header bar is still one white strip, not darker over the sidebar. Faint lines remain between threads. The window buttons are in close, minimise, maximise order. The message body is monospace, and the header bar is shorter than libadwaita's.

changed: The header bar is libadwaita's height, and its part over the folder sidebar takes the sidebar colour. The window buttons are in GNOME's order (minimise, maximise, close). Plain-text mail shows in Adwaita Sans instead of monospace, and the open message's subject is a bold page title.
gaps: Faint lines still run between threads (another element draws them). The thread list has no header of its own ("Inbox · 5 unread"). Reply and forward sit in the message card, not the header bar. There's Mailspring's contact panel on the right, and no avatars. The search field and these layout points are Mailspring's own and can't change with a stylesheet.

changed: Window buttons now follow GNOME's button-layout setting live: side, which buttons and order. This is done by a small companion plugin that reads the setting through the desktop portal. Tested with right, left, close-only on either side, and none.
gaps: Plugin evaluation in docs/mailspring-adwaita.md. Reply/Forward in the header bar and initials avatars are feasible with a plugin, through supported slots. A thread-list header would be fragile. Row heights, the split header layout, window corners and native menus can't change.

changed: Reply, Reply all and Forward are now in the message pane's header bar, added by the companion plugin through Mailspring's supported toolbar slot. They do exactly what Mailspring's own reply does. The window buttons still follow GNOME's layout live (v4).
gaps: Mailspring places plugin buttons after its own, so the reply group isn't first as in the mock, and its icons are a little larger than the neighbouring ones. The rest is as v3: faint lines between threads; no thread-list header (a plugin could only add one by fragile DOM changes); the contact panel; no avatars yet (feasible next, through a plugin slot).

changed: A detail pass, no new features. Header buttons are flat libadwaita-style buttons (transparent until hover, rounded, even gaps), every icon in a 16 px box, and the compose button clear of the top edge. Mailspring's icons are replaced by GNOME's Adwaita symbolic icons, loaded from the system's icon theme (nothing copied; Mailspring's own icon stays if one is missing). The selected thread and the Inbox row are inset pills with even margins; the separators between threads are gone; the search field is padded off the divider and matches the buttons' height; the sidebar count is a plain dim number; the contact panel starts hidden (the sidebar button in the header brings it back); the message card and the reply box sit 12 px clear of the edges with the time and Reply centred on the sender's line, and the dashed line above "Write a reply…" is a soft solid one. The mock's two broken icons are fixed.
gaps: Things only GNOME's toolkit can do: rounded window corners, native menus and dialogs, GNOME's split header, row heights. Mailspring still puts the plugin's Reply group after its own buttons. No avatars yet, no thread-list header, and the unread dot and attachment file-type icons are still Mailspring's (Adwaita has no match).
checked: 200% crops of the header bar, sidebar, thread list and message card, light and dark, next to the mock: nothing within 4 px of a border or edge; no lines or ticks between threads (checked pixel by pixel down the thread list and along its right edge); all icons 16 px, centred, the same colour, with even padding; the selected thread and the Inbox row inset evenly; no raw unstyled widgets (the contact panel's raw controls are gone).

changed: Two fixes on v6. Window buttons: libadwaita's 24 px circles, 37 px apart, with Adwaita's own window-minimize/maximize/close-symbolic glyphs at 16 px from the system icon theme (the maximize glyph had read as a small circle). Dark mode: the message card is libadwaita's dark card, a step lighter than the pane with a faint outline, and the reply strip under it is the same colour.
checked: Window buttons at 400% next to the mock's, light and dark: same size, glyphs and spacing, within a pixel; the header's last button stays clear of them. The message card at 200%, light and dark: the card and reply strip are one colour, lighter than the pane in dark mode, with even edges; light mode unchanged.
